text.text: Legend has it that deep within Pallantis, an ancient land lies buried beneath the sands. In this forgotten realm, a Palmon with the power to create miracles once lived in harmony with humans. It was an era of unparalleled prosperity, until a cataclysm forced the Palmon into eternal slumber, and the land, along with its miracles, was swallowed by the sands. Now, that long-lost Palmon has risen from the dunes once more, awaiting a new companion to bond with.
